name: okgate
description: Put okgate, an MCP policy proxy, in front of your MCP servers: a dry-run first, then spend caps, approvals for destructive tools, a kill switch and a hash-chained audit log. /okgate:init sets it up; /okgate:report explains a run; /okgate:audit shows which GEMINI.md / AGENTS.md rules your agents broke; /okgate:hooks sets up hook mode.
